rule: Public Team USA data only for Team USA facts
implementation: Uses official Team USA, USOPC, and Census public aggregate references; no private data.
Files contain only U.S./Team USA Olympic and Paralympic aggregate data.
No athlete names, images, profile URLs, bios, or likenesses included.
Files include no IOC marks, rings, logos, or protected assets.
No score or points fields included.
Includes sport-level medal counts only. Placement schema prepared but not populated where not sourced.
Pass only these aggregate files to Gemini, not raw roster rows.
Included files are sourced from public references and include provenance. Missing full roster-level rows are intentionally not fabricated.
